318: How soon will I receive a profile? ▾
319: You receive a qualified profile within 24 to 72 hours directly on your WhatsApp. If it is urgent, contact us directly on WhatsApp at +212 691 733 585.
320: What happens if I am not satisfied? ▾
321: The Peace of Mind and Premium packages include replacements for 2 months and 6 months respectively. Simply contact us on WhatsApp; the exact conditions are explained before the placement.
322: How are the placement fees paid? ▾
323: The placement fees are paid only after the profile is approved and the placement is made. You pay nothing before you have found your candidate. The monthly salary is paid directly to the employee, separately from the placement fees.
324: What is the difference between live-in and live-out? ▾
325:
Live-in: the employee lives at your home 24/7. She gets one day off per week or per fortnight, as agreed.

Live-out: she works Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, and goes home in the evening. Ideal for families with no spare room.
326: Which cities do you cover? ▾
327: We work in the following main cities: Casablanca, Bouskoura, Dar Bouazza, Bouznika, Rabat, Marrakech, Tanger, Agadir, Fès, Kénitra, Mohammedia, Témara and Salé, and other cities depending on requests. The daily cleaning service is available only in Casablanca and Rabat.
328: Is the staff really checked and trained? ▾
329: Yes, absolutely. Every candidate goes through a rigorous selection process: interview, background checks, skills assessment and training in the Yallah Services standards. We only present profiles we trust.
330: What is the employee's monthly salary? ▾
331: • Cleaning: villa 4,500 MAD · mini villa 4,000 MAD · apartment 3,500 MAD
332: • Nanny: 1 child 3,500 MAD (+ cleaning 4,000 MAD) · 2 children with cleaning 4,500/5,000 MAD · 3 children 4,500 MAD (+ cleaning 5,000 MAD)
333: • Cooking: simple cooking 4,000 MAD · cooking/cleaning 5,000 MAD · kitchen help 3,500 MAD · kitchen help/cleaning 4,000 MAD
335: • Daily (Casa & Rabat): cleaning 600 MAD/week · cleaning + cooking 800 MAD/week · cleaning + nanny 800 MAD/week
336: How does the first meeting with the employee work? ▾
337: After the profile is approved on WhatsApp, we arrange a meeting or interview between the employee and the family. If everything suits you, the placement is confirmed. If not, we offer another profile free of charge.
338: Does the employee speak French and Arabic? ▾
339: Most of our candidates speak French and understand Moroccan Arabic (Darija) or standard Arabic. We adapt the profile we propose to the language preferences you mention in your request.
340: What happens if the employee falls ill or leaves? ▾
341: In the event of a long absence, a departure or a difficulty with the person presented, Yallah Services follows the situation and applies the replacement provided by the package you chose, for the stated period.
342: Can I hire the employee directly, without going through the agency? ▾
343: No. Under the terms of the placement contract, any direct recruitment of the same employee without prior agreement from Yallah Services is a breach of contract. Our candidates are placed exclusively through our agency.
344: Is there a signed contract between the agency and the client? ▾
345: Yes. Yallah Services draws up an official placement contract between the agency and the client household, setting out each party's commitments, the guarantees, the placement fees and the replacement conditions. This contract protects you.
